primary_estimand: Paper's exercise estimand: pre- (baseline) vs post-exercise (Bruce treadmill) plasma exRNA miRNA abundance, within deconvoluted cargo profiles and by DESeq2 on read counts (Baseline n=26 vs post-Exercise n=26). The exercise samples are in GSE121874 (S4.3.1.p1; KRT row 'Small RNA-seq during acute maximal exercise', GEO GSE121874). GSE121868 is the subarachnoid hemorrhage CSF/plasma atlas dataset used only as an input to cargo-type deconvolution.
planned_contrasts: post-Exercise vs Baseline miRNAs (S2.11.p3, S4.6.2.8.p1; paper: 53 DE miRNAs across 3 cargo types by deconvolution t-test; DESeq2 'Shah et al.' circle in Fig 7C) -- samples in GSE121874, not in GSE121868
paper_method: exceRpt read counts; deconvolution (Stage 2) per group + t-test per cargo profile with FDR; DESeq2 Baseline vs post-Exercise
role_of_this_accession: GSE121868: aSAH patients only (no controls), 523 plasma/CSF samples from 30 donors; used for cargo-type discovery (S4.3.1.p1), no exercise factor
paper_results: 53 DE miRNAs (17 overlap Shah et al. DESeq2: CT3B 1, CT4 16); CT4 proportion change p=0.001 (S2.11.p2-p3, FIG7)
